cards.style: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm
cards.header: px-4 py-3 border-b border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/80 flex justify-between items-center

buttons.primary: bg-amber-500 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-amber-400 font-semibold rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.buy: bg-emerald-500 text-white hover:bg-emerald-400 font-bold rounded-md px-4 py-2
buttons.sell: bg-rose-500 text-white hover:bg-rose-400 font-bold rounded-md px-4 py-2

data_displays.live_ticker: Flex container with large JetBrains Mono text, color-coded based on live tick direction, flashing animation on update.
data_displays.gauge_chart: Use Recharts PieChart (half donut) for Toros vs Osos.
data_displays.timeframe_badges: Small rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold

specific_sections.header: Logo XAU/USD Señales, Source Selector (OANDA/Gold-API), Live Server Time, Ping.
left_column: Sesiones de Mercado (Sidney, Tokyo, London, NY) with active/inactive dot indicator.
Indicadores de Fuerza (Tendencia, Momentum, Volatilidad, Volumen, Confianza) via progress bars.
Estadísticas del Sistema (Efectividad %, Total Señales, Activas).
center_column: Main Price Header (Live XAU/USD, spread, volatilidad, high/low).
Active Signal Card (COMPRA/VENTA huge badge, Confianza %, Entrada, TP1, TP2, TP3, SL).
Predicción Próxima Vela (1M/5M CALL/PUT binary options).
right_column: Historial de Señales (Recent signals list, outcome Ganada/Perdida, Pips).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text passes APCA contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Use .jsx or .js extensions for components, not .tsx.
Apply JetBrains Mono to all numeric prices and percentages.
Apply Manrope to headings and standard labels.
The entire UI MUST be in Spanish.
Avoid standard Shadcn Cards; build custom div structures for the dense Control Room bento layout to have maximum padding/spacing control.
Ensure the color palette relies strictly on the provided Emerald (Buy) and Rose (Sell) shades alongside deep Zinc blacks.
Include all data-testid attributes across interactive UI elements.
